title: Input validation hardening: malformed JSON, oversized payloads, hostile game definitions
description: Validate all external inputs at system boundaries. Malformed JSON must produce clear errors, not panics. Oversized payloads must be rejected before parsing. Game definitions with circular references, absurd dimensions (1M×1M boards), negative values, NaN/Inf floats, and deeply nested structures must be caught at load time. Both Rust and Python engines.
